hypothesis: A Runtime.plan/native_busy/done/ready call was performed while holding the global cross-cohort dispatch lock. One stalled original metadata call could stop both cohorts on all new nodes. Per-node verification was also synchronous across cohorts.
attribution: Codex introduced the global claim gate around the whole Pool.tick scan in ea68d28. Prior independent-startup tests covered actor construction and CPU preparation, but did not block real actor metadata calls.

tested.data: Original-runtime CPU actor fixture with plan/verification/readiness/native-lock/output checks blocked until the other cohort enters its actual fixture execute method. Force the blocked cohort first; no model or GPU.
tested.controls: Both directions: slow Qwen must allow OLMo execute; slow OLMo must allow Qwen execute. Existing initializers and prepare barriers, exact runtime snapshots, real five-seed DAG, held legacy Qwen leases, checkpoint retention and concurrent claim tests.
tested.seeds_updates: Production DAG seeds5-9 are metadata-only fixtures; CPU toy runner retains updates25/50/75. No H100 model updates or new scientific values.
tested.metrics: Process completion, actual CPU fixture execute entry, kernel task lease exclusion, preserved binding/task definitions and checkpoint bytes. Not measured training reward/held-out reward/throughput.

fix: Inspect each original actor under only its cohort control lease, independently of the other actor. Once inspection finishes, carry an advisory immutable task offer. Re-read binding, phase, failures, task semantics and kernel leases before claim. The cross-cohort gate only compares held leases and claims tasks; it performs no Runtime RPC or numerical/ledger scan.
checkpoint_provenance: No checkpoint, optimizer/RNG, reward, failed attempt, frozen scientific input or original Runtime binding was deleted/reset/relabelled. Thirty original srgc_rebuttal file hashes match the retained baseline. Existing coordinator/runner snapshots remain archived.
limitations: Actual user H100 status/log/stack has not been received; this reproduced blocker is fixed but its role in the current remote OLMo failure and actual OLMo startup/throughput remain unverified. Existing already-running workers retain their frozen code until rerun. No paid API/model call, allocation, service or listener started.
